Garage description
The "Taiga" camouflage paint masks the tank so well in thick vegetation, that you could probably sneak up on a moose with your tank.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint appeared on August 26, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Taiga's price was 210,000 crystals and could be bought from General onwards.
Legacy paint description:
An all-around paint that offers solid protection against Firebird, Twins, Isida and Ricochet. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
